reviews.text:
I am very glad that I chose Sun Dream Yacht Charters to host my Fortieth Birthday Party. I will never forget the memories we made. Kristen did a very good job of guiding me on pricing, payment dates, venue location, venue info, DJ coordination, food options, and drink options. Zachary gave me a tour of the yacht. He and the captain were even graceful enough to give the few people who were running late ample time to get to the party. According to the captain, we had so much fun, that we actually ‘rocked the boat’ (not his words, but pun intended).

The Sun Dream Yacht is docked at the rear of the Gallery One-Double Tree by Hilton hotel. It is a 30-45 second walk from the rear of the hotel. The Sun Dream Yacht was clean and was large enough to accommodate all fifty-nine of my guests. Food options are divided into the Classic Menu (the one I chose), the Sterling Menu, and the Gold Menu. The Classic Menu has an three elegant displays of appetizers to choose from (select 1), three green and grain appetizers (select 1) nine passed starters (five premium, select 2), 12 dinner entrees (four premium, select 2), nine sides (select 2), and two desserts (select 1). Bar Service is divided into the Top Shelf (7 liquors) and Premium Bar (9 liquors) Service. Non-alcoholic drinks are free, but alcoholic drinks are available upon purchase.

The food tasted top-notch and the bar service was excellent. Make sure you pick the Spinach and Artichoke Rangoon for your appetizer. I took Kristin’s advice and didn’t regret it.

For those pondering on whether they want to spend money on their ‘Milestone Birthday’ (thirty, forty, or fifty), consider the following. Imagine yourself either doing nothing or attending a small dinner at the house, restaurant, or venue you frequent for that ‘Milestone Birthday.’ Would you be satisfied with that a week, two weeks, a month, and three months for now? Could you look at yourself in the mirror six months from now and be satisfied that you missed out on the opportunity celebrate that ‘Milestone?’ I’m in no way stating that money isn’t important and you shouldn’t do it if you can’t afford it. However, if you can either right away or within the year, consider those questions before you say no to going big for your ‘Milestone.’ Sun Dream is happy to help if you say yes.

If you do say yes, make sure you hire a photographer as well. You won’t have time to take good pictures on your own and your guests may not be photography savants. Consider planning for this six months in advance so that you can get your guests locked in and less likely to have last minute cancellations. Use Evite to send mass invitations. Event invites get buried in Facebook notifications.

I had the chance to spend some time with Walker in his workshop and see firsthand how much care and attention goes into his guitars. He's incredibly passionate about his craft, and it's clear he takes a lot of pride in what he builds. Really enjoyed getting to know him and seeing his process!
I highly recommend Doubleday guitars. It was a pleasure working with Walker. His work is outstanding and if you're looking to buy a custom boutique guitar, this is the place.

Walker is rightly known as an exceptional luthier for Fender-style custom guitars, especially Telecasters.  He also does some occasional setup and finishing work and, not surprisingly, excels at both.  He did some finish and setup work on my 1990s Les Paul Special and the guitar looks and plays better than ever!  The finish work was particularly tricky - matching the original color without refinishing the whole guitar - and it turned out great … far exceeded my expectations!  Five stars!

Fabulous guitar maker and luthier! Check him out. He put his work up against a Plek machine and matched it 1:1. Awesome craftsmanship. Winds his own pickups.
Former Collings superstar now doing his own thing. Get one of his creations now before word gets out too far!
I met Walker for the first time today. Nothing but good impressions after talking with him and playing one of his instruments. First class man. 👌

I started playing it and the caption bubble appeared above my head “I CAN’T BELIVE IT’S NOT BUTTA!@” But seriously he’s rad so take your guitars to him!

Absolutely wonderful guitars and an even more amazing guy. Walker is not only extremely talented and super knowledgeable but very communicative and a pleasure to work with. Highly recommend you stop by and check his guitars out.

Had to get my PRS guitars perfectly set up and intonated for some recording for my band and WOW! They played better than they ever have before! He has great communication and super easy to talk to and work with. 10/10 would recommend and come back one day for a complete custom guitar!

Recently I took my JET JS400 (Fender Strat Style) Guitar to Walker’s shop to do some maintenance work on the nut, bridge, string height and shielding paint inside the body to reduce buzz and humming noise. My guitar plays a lot better now and Thanks to Walker for doing a tremendous job, Excellent customer service and I highly recommend him to anyone who wants their guitar or bass setup properly.

First. The customer service and availability of speaking with Walker about the guitar was like no other.
Second. The guitar itself is incredible. I'm a collector that's had over 100 guitars in my hands over the years and own over 20 now. That is the best guitar out of the case that I've ever played, and one of my favorites by far. It's beautifully built, the woods and material are incredible, and it just has this luxurious feel on the neck. I don't know how else to describe it but it's like no other guitar I've ever picked up. I love T type, Or in this case the Broadwing For the blues. This guitar takes the cake. The pick ups are awesome too in the neck pup pretty much the best I've heard for blues type music along with the playability. Can't wait to get my hands on one of his S type guitars.

To have a chance to support an individual builder like this is also icing on the cake in my opinion. Just playing this guitar knowing how it was built along with the love and care that was put into it makes it one of the most special guitars In my collection

In all things considered, you can't beat the price either.

3 Creek Pavers was an absolute pleasure to deal with, from initial response, creative design/lay out and throughout install process. Ryan and team did an excellent job removing our existing-damaged driveway and installing a high quality & superior paver driveway that looks incredible for our low country home.
3Creek did an excellent job on my patio. Ryan was very helpful throughout the process and very good at communicating. The team worked swiftly and did a quality job.

Given the consistent praise among the completed reviews, I would have hoped for a better experience than I had, regrettably. I hired 3 Creek to do a large patio project (pavers) and gabled covered-porch structure. I had initially only planned to hire 3Creek for the paver work, but they assured me that they could, as a single vendor, also complete the covered patio structure that would be built onto a detached garage. Wanting to do things by the book, I also enlisted them to permit the project with the city.

The project actually moved fairly quickly, but it did take longer than they had anticipated. Some small on site changes may have contributed to that extended duration of work, and associated run-up in costs. However, I would say that communication around cost escalations was quite poor, and at the end of the project, we were hit with an additional $8,000 charge. About $2000 of that was expected due to increases in the square-footage of pavers that was added during the project. The rest was a complete surprise. That's never fun.

The quality of the work was good, but I was disappointed in the commitment to finishing the project with professionalism. Sections of the polymeric sand used in the paver creases never seemed to cure properly, and large sections of the sand immediately eroded away and remained soft, producing a less than ideal appearance. This issue was present before the final payment and the PM noted that they would have someone come out and touch it up. I contacted the project manager and instead of trying to remedy the issue, he simply told me where I could go buy more of the polymeric sand and that I could fill it in myself. When you spend $30k+ on a project, I don’t think it is unreasonable to ask that it be completed with an eye for the small details. I followed-up with another email a few months later, and it went unanswered. I always want to give vendors a chance to address issues. It’s ok if things aren’t perfect from the outset, but the difference between an acceptable and a great contractor is their commitment to making things right. Unfortunately that piece was missing here.
3 Creek did an amazing job with replacing our driveway from start to finish.  And the pavers are beautiful!
